description: Synthesize expressive multi-instrument harmonic music (grand piano, Karplus-Strong acoustic guitar, bowed fiddle/cello, jazz Rhodes/brass, modal drums + Hadamard FDN reverb) and encode spec-compliant ISO/IEC 11172-3 MPEG-1 Layer III (.mp3) plus lossless .flac/.wav directly in pure zero-float integer arithmetic with embedded ID3v2.4 TXXX:AMB-128 provenance (0 libmp3lame/LGPL deps, 0 float opcodes). Trigger when users ask for /mp3, /music, 5-limit vs 12-TET A/B audio, 7-limit jazz/blues MP3, 3-limit fiddle reel, 432 Hz calm piano/guitar/cello, or synthwave MP3.

bpm.description: Tempo in integer BPM (48..220). [Zero-Float Unit: integer BPM]

durationSeconds.description: Track duration in integer seconds (4..180, default 8). [Zero-Float Unit: integer seconds]

preset.description: Optional preset: just_intonation_vs_12tet, just_5limit_pure_stem, twelve_tet_tempered_stem, jazz_7limit_quartet, folk_3limit_fiddle, calm_piano_guitar_cello, synthwave_scifi. [Zero-Float Unit: preset slug]

prompt.description: Natural-language music request or harmonic tuning prompt. [Zero-Float Unit: UTF-8 text]

rootHz.description: Integer root pitch Hz (default 220; pass 216 or 432 for 432 Hz concert pitch). [Zero-Float Unit: integer Hz]

name: affine_synthesize_music_mp3
